# Third-party assets used by SchoolSafe

The files listed here are distributed locally so the card and PWA surfaces work without a CDN. SHA-256 values identify the exact files reviewed on 2026-09-01.

| Component | Version / source | License | Local files |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| QRCode.js | `davidshimjs/qrcodejs`, CDN distribution identified as 1.0.0 | MIT | `qrcode.min.js` — `c541ef06327885a8415bca8df6071e14189b4855336def4f36db54bde8484f36` |
| html2canvas | 1.4.1, `niklasvh/html2canvas` | MIT | `html2canvas.min.js` — `e87e550794322e574a1fda0c1549a3c70dae5a93d9113417a429016838eab8cb` |
| Baloo 2 | Ek Type / Google Fonts | SIL Open Font License 1.1 | `Baloo2-700.woff2`, `Baloo2-800.woff2` — both `26fb4610d4bc976d2584ca15e66c11465dbc1f267a10dca668fcb3080dfe59c1` |
| Nunito Sans | Nunito Sans Project Authors / Google Fonts | SIL Open Font License 1.1 | `NunitoSans-700.woff2`, `NunitoSans-800.woff2`, `NunitoSans-900.woff2` — all `c9746ad68c8a1a94e9d8981ae5093fd4df05b6809e8b5afecd08df1a3bdb7e62` |

Sources:

- https://github.com/davidshimjs/qrcodejs
- https://github.com/niklasvh/html2canvas/tree/v1.4.1
- https://github.com/EkType/Baloo2
- https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/nunitosans

The complete MIT and SIL OFL 1.1 license texts are stored beside this notice as `LICENSE-MIT.txt` and `LICENSE-OFL-1.1.txt`.
